acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with a check that exits 1 and record the envelope.
Either ok is false for a failed check or the contract documents ok as transport success and a test pins the check-failure field.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

Suspected defect. In batch C stage 3, the tests-cmd-corvint lifecycle check exited 1 (two real failures), but dogfood verify's envelope reported ok:true at the top level. A caller that reads only ok would treat a failed check as passing. Expected: either ok reflects the check result, or the field's meaning (command ran vs check passed) is documented and a separate pass/fail field is prominent. Version: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360.

All 15 hosted CI checks passed on head b6f3eb78. The batch CEM was bound, checked and sealed (commit 1e15a6f1), and Codex reviewed each lane and the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-08-v1-1012-verify-ok-mirrors-exit.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-i-integration.md at that commit (each digest is that file’s sha256); the build logs record the focused tests and limits. Requirement LCP-V0-017 was accepted by the owner (decision 0465). Delivery stays experimental. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner preference for scoped work).

title: dogfood verify reports top-level ok:true when a check exits non-zero (suspected)
